A-B-A publishes six messages with five handled and two skipped deliveries; callback state, no-subscriber messages and separate sender/receiver provenance are visible in three languages at 390px.
A second run starts from empty state and event sequence 0, clears the event filter and reaches the same publication/delivery trace; no game progress is restored from disk.
The same A-B-A transition sequence also reaches ready in a native Godot window; the task survives panel close/reopen and explicit cancellation stops the owned session.

The visible multi-scene project is reviewed, downloaded, independently verified, extracted elsewhere and started by real Godot with the identical A-B-A visit sequence and identical event publications/deliveries, shared-state mutations and audio shutdown between scenes.

Separate publisher and subscriber actions open the matching frozen behavior document; property identities differ and author files remain unchanged. Exact text selection is asserted only for a supplied source range.
